openings.claim: Order staging/count checks may reduce switching/selection delays and errors.
openings.discriminator: Selection/checking improves while insertion stays unchanged.
openings.probe: Counterbalance current/staged cycles across workers/layouts with <=15 reusable samples; time all stages/overhead, verify counts/color, inspect wear.
openings.uncertainty: Layout complexity confounds switching; bench fit and reuse effects unknown.

openings.claim: Template silhouettes, including duplicate positions, may expose omissions/substitutions.
openings.discriminator: Improved seeded-error detection versus current checks; total time exposes overhead.
openings.probe: Verify template revisions, parts and independent component lists; test spare-board surfaces across workers/mixed layouts; check color separately.
openings.uncertainty: Shape distinction unverified; customer arrangement untested.

openings.claim: Ordered-layout guidance with a short-partition cue may resolve confusion.
openings.discriminator: Better first placement/fewer questions support instruction ambiguity; persistent confusion weakens it.
openings.probe: Verify diagram coverage/current parts; randomize ten participants, balance layouts, compare current/revised diagrams with verified-complete sets. Record unaided success/time, placement/failure step and annotation overhead.
openings.uncertainty: Five per condition: exploratory; cue/layout effects combined.

decision: Probe before adoption; preserve 30x20 cm footprint, assortment, removability, accepted counts/colors and deadline; costs <=500 initially and <=0.40/order. Verify 60-order targets separately: >=98% complete, median <=8 minutes, >=90% unaided arrangement. Synthetic observations establish no mechanism; overlapping widths cannot identify insertion difficulty.
